question: Can every reported analysis roster be reconstructed from count-bearing upstream reports and authoritative prediction ledgers without treating unavailable raw-record counts as final counts?
stages: source cells and source record candidates where retained upstream
missing_count_rule: Use null/NR when an upstream report did not retain a comparable raw-record total; never substitute the final scored count.
interpretation: Counts describe evidence flow, not independent sample size. Repeated records remain nested within physical cells and cells within datasets.
